The interaction between atmospheric gases and radiation is a key factor in the Earth's energy balance. Which row in the table correctly identifies how greenhouse gases generally behave toward incoming short-wavelength solar radiation and outgoing long-wavelength terrestrial radiation?

Short-wavelength solar radiationLong-wavelength terrestrial radiation
AMostly absorbedMostly transmitted
BMostly transmittedMostly absorbed
CMostly transmittedMostly transmitted
DMostly absorbedMostly absorbed
